strings.en: I'll play with you for a while.
Vete, you can follow that man to the grave.
Ing... In the end, you're just His...
If you're the chosen one, then I...
The SRX is nothing but a defective product.
So that man's plan is still stalled.
Heh, not while it's still a prototype.
Any more of this is a waste of time.
Keep me company a little longer.
Your eye for weak points wasn't bad, though.
Did I go in too deep...?!
More power than expected... Is that their trait?
You must have realized it already.
...So they're not just a ragtag bunch.
...I see. Now I understand why the Galilnagant lost.
We both still have room to spare.
Your power can't be only this much, can it?
To fall behind that man's pawns...
You intend to fight while separated?
Prototype or not, it has some power.
The SRX... It seems they've improved it somewhat.
What's wrong? Is just hitting me all you can do?
No match for the Golar Golem.
You were granted power by Him.../　and this is all you can do?
That man chose his members poorly.
I even know your next move, Vete.
You haven't grown at all, SRX Team.
You're still not on a level to fight me.
Leave the rest to me, Spectra.
